Chat with MeshCore users (direct messages and channels) and carry OSHI messages over MeshCore repeaters. Needs MeshCore companion firmware for Bluetooth. OSHI adds one channel, #oshi-bridge, in a free slot and never changes your other channels.
MeshCore radios show up in the radio scan below, marked MeshCore.
